name: rsvper
description: A self-hostable wedding invite and RSVP app for Cloudflare Workers + D1.

scripts.dev: node scripts/build.mjs && wrangler d1 migrations apply DB --local && wrangler dev
scripts.deploy: npm run build && wrangler d1 migrations apply DB --remote && wrangler deploy

DB.description: D1 database that stores your settings, invites and replies. Created for you automatically.

ADMIN_PASSWORD.description: Password for the /admin dashboard. Use at least 12 characters; a long passphrase is best. You can change it later from Settings.

SESSION_SECRET.description: Random secret (at least 32 characters) used to sign admin sessions and key the rate limiter. Generate one with: openssl rand -base64 32
